description:
Track all your AI coding subscription usage from the Windows system tray.

OpenTokenUsage is a lightweight system-tray app that tracks how much of your AI coding subscriptions you've used (Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, and more) in one place. It is a Windows fork of OpenUsage with full Windows support, a plugin-based provider system, and a local HTTP usage API.
GitHub Copilot usage now also works for GitHub Enterprise Cloud accounts. Thanks to @OzmaXochi.
New Features
- Copilot: GitHub Enterprise Cloud (*.ghe.com) accounts. The plugin uses the host in GH_HOST, otherwise github.com, then any *.ghe.com login the GitHub CLI has stored; log in with gh auth login --hostname <host>. A token only ever goes to its own host (#14 by @OzmaXochi)
